relations.subject: Khenpo Tsültrim Gyamtso Rinpoche
relations.evidence: He left home at an early age to train with Lama Zopa Tarchin, who was to become his root guru.

relations.subject: Khenpo Tsültrim Gyamtso Rinpoche
relations.evidence: At Tsurphu Monastery, the historic seat of the Karma Kagyu lineage, Rinpoche continued his training with the lineage head, the 16th Gyalwa Karmapa, and other masters.

relations.subject: Khenpo Tsültrim Gyamtso Rinpoche
relations.role: principal teacher at the shedra (monastic college)
relations.evidence: Along with Khenchen Thrangu Rinpoche, Khenpo Rinpoche served as the principal teacher at the shedra (monastic college) at Rumtek Monastery
